name: Point Calculus Faceted Solid Raycasting
aliases: Faceted Solid Intersection in Point Calculus
Ray-Solid Intersection via Point Calculus Edge Cases
Visualization of Geometric Models of Faceted Solids in Point Calculus
definition: A raycasting method for visualizing faceted solids (e.g., tetrahedrons, prisms) defined in 'point calculus'. It computes the intersection of a ray with the solid by solving systems of equations using the Newton method, rather than using explicit geometric primitives or signed distance functions for curved surfaces.
